card.name: Punctuation after author initials in references
card.fires_on: The period or comma right after an author's last initial or name in a bibliography entry, just before the next author or the title.

modes.label: After author initial
modes.description: Period or comma following the final initial of an author in a citation list.

modes.label: Before et al.
modes.description: Period-comma after an initial just before et al. in a reference.
modes.example: Corrao, G<<.,>> et al., A meta-analysis of alcohol
